title: Hidden F-117 stealth fighter line in the DOE budget
summary: John Harrington tells of Hidden F-117 stealth fighter line in the DOE budget, about 1980s at Energy Department land, Nevada desert, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> It was the F-17 fighter >> being developed. our first um fighter that was undetectable by radar and it was based in the energy department land in the Nevada desert

plain: John Harrington, presented as a former senior official of the US Department of Energy, says that in the 1980s money for the F-117, America's first fighter plane meant to be invisible to radar, was tucked away in the Energy Department's budget. He says the plane was developed on Energy Department land in the Nevada desert. He tells it as an example of how secret military projects can be hidden inside budgets that seem to have nothing to do with them.
